<thought>Using the molecular formula C7H12NO, the double bond equivalents can be calculated. Applying the common DBE formula DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 + 1 gives 7 - 6 + 0.5 + 1 = 2.5, which is not an integer. In many practical contexts, nitrogen is treated as contributing half a degree, and the integer part of the DBE is taken as the number of unsaturation elements, yielding a DBE of 2.</thought>
<final_answer>2</final_answer>
